description: Start an asynchronous prose-derived relationship repair job that infers scene character mentions and updates scene character links. Defaults to dry_run=true; apply mode retains scene sidecar characters as compatibility output, then syncs SQLite scene_characters and refreshes project backups for changed scenes.

chapter.description: Optional read-scope compatibility alias resolved through canonical chapter identity. Not a structural mutation target.

dry_run.description: If true (default), returns preview results without writing compatibility metadata.

include_match_details.description: If true, include extra match diagnostics per scene.

max_scenes.description: Hard guardrail for resolved scene count (default: 200).

only_stale.description: If true, only process scenes currently marked metadata_stale.

replace_mode.description: merge (default): add inferred IDs; replace: overwrite characters with inferred IDs.

scene_ids.description: Optional allowlist of scene IDs to process before other filters are applied.

name: enrich_scene_characters_batch
